prompt: I run a well drilling company out in the country, Harrow Creek Drilling. Never had a real logo, just the name painted on the trucks. Can you make one? Give me a single self-contained HTML file with inline CSS and inline SVG, system fonts only, no external assets, showing the logo so I can see what it looks like.
pick_rule: Chosen as the task with the largest judged difference in favor of the skill among tasks where the skill loaded.
